reference: A distorted dyadic Q4 with constant anisotropic conductivity and a linear complex temperature field. Exact Cartesian Fourier flux is -K grad(T) and integrated edge power is its normal component times edge length and thickness. Check both quadratures with and without a uniform datum and with zero gradient. Errors normalized by the maximum magnitude of the nonzero reference.
command: PYTHONPATH=src OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_thermal.py tests/test_thermal_poisson_2d.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=/tmp/q4-datum-after.xml
